{{External|rs|rsc=Rune Plate Mail Body}} {{Infobox Item |name = Rune platebody |image = [[File:Rune platebody.png]] |release = [[23 September]] [[2001]] |update = Dragon quest online! |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Wear, Drop |examine = Provides excellent protection. |value = 65000 |weight = 9.979 |exchange = Yes |id = 1127 }} [[File:Rune platebody detail.png|left|150px]] The '''rune platebody''' is an armour used in [[melee]] and the strongest of all [[free-to-play]] [[Platebody|platebodies]]. It requires 40 [[Defence]] and completion of the [[quest]] [[Dragon Slayer I]] to equip. It also provides greater protection than a [[rune chainbody]], with the exception of a slightly lower crush defence. Like all platebodies, however, it gives a crippling negative bonus to the user's [[Ranged]] and [[Magic]] stats. Players with level 99 [[Smithing]] can make one by using 5 [[runite bar]]s on an [[anvil]] while carrying a [[hammer]], granting 375 [[experience]]. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = 0 |aslash = 0 |acrush = 0 |amagic = -30 |arange = -15 |dstab = +82 |dslash = +80 |dcrush = +72 |dmagic = -6 |drange = +80 |str = 0 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = body |image = [[File:Rune platebody equipped male.png|170px]] |altimage = [[File:Rune platebody equipped female.png|170px]] }} ==Creation== {{Recipe |skill1 = Smithing |skill1lvl = 99 |skill1boostable = Yes |skill1exp = 375 |members = No |ticks = 5 |tools = Hammer |facilities = Anvil |mat1 = Runite bar |mat1quantity = 5 |output1 = Rune platebody }} ==Products== {{Uses material list|Rune platebody}} ==Treasure Trails== {{EmoteClue}} * {{FaloItem|rune platebody|To slay a dragon you must first do, before this chest piece can be put on you.}} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Rune platebody}} ===Shop locations=== {{Store locations list|Rune platebody}} ==Used in recommended equipment== {{Used in recommended equipment|Rune platebody}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 21 April 2021 |update = Fishing Trawler Improvements and Equipment Rebalance: Part One |change = The platebody's ranged attack bonus has been decreased from -10 to -15. }} {{Subject changes |date = 7 February 2006 |update = Cabin Fever |change = The item's examine was changed from undefined ("''It's a Rune platebody.''") to "''Provides excellent protection''." }} {{Subject changes |date = 7 March 2005 |update = Mountain Daughter and Changes |change = The item was graphically updated. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Rune platebody detail (historical).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Rune platebody detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Rune platebody (historical).png|center]] |[[File:Rune platebody.png|center]] |- |29 March 2004 ⁠–
